insights.title: Short sleep
insights.finding: After nights under 6 h, walks ran about 3.5× harder.

insights.title: Low HRV
insights.finding: On days your HRV was 15% or more below usual, walks ran more than 4× harder.

insights.title: Lower readiness
insights.finding: With readiness under 70, Solidcore ran about 3× harder.

insights.title: Time of day
insights.finding: Your morning walks ran a bit harder than late-day ones.

insights.title: Walks vs Solidcore
insights.finding: Solidcore and walks have kept your heart rate up about equally.

insights.title: Recovery after sessions
insights.finding: How quickly your heart rate settles after sessions has stayed about the same (around 46 bpm drop in ~10 min).

caveat: Patterns in your own history, not medical advice.
